name: Spell Cast
description: A short forward spell cast: the hands gather in front of the chest, then push out as the body leans forward, and settle back while the effect leaves the hands.
poses: gather: hands drawn together in front of the chest, elbows bent, chin down
charge: hands apart slightly, body coiling, head coming up
release: hands pushed forward, body leaning into the cast
settle: arms lowering, body straightening, head level
